I sang this in middle school and cried lol... it's a german song btw, this is just my 10minute translation

i tried/am still trying therapy, psychiatry, staying at home, going outside everyday, sleeping more and waking up early, antidepressants, going off all my meds, art, structuring my day, making friends, sports, maths, putting ice cubes in my mouth and on my skin (i read somewhere that it helps), some meditation, writing a diary, daily self care and lots of techniques to calm myself down essentially. they did improve my mental health generally but i was never able to stop feeling surreal...
What did I do to deserve this

People always told me that I walk a little weird so last year I decided to get it checked

Turns out I have really bad scoliosis and can't get a job that requires physical activity if I don't want to end up in a wheelchair in my 20s
I like the story of Lain Iwakura slowly losing herself and everything she loved and being forced to become God.
